levels.surface: أبا عبد الله جعفر بن محمد

notes: The opening «وبالإسناد الأول» is kept as a back reference: all previous reports (prev1 to prev12) have has_written_chain false and none supplies a chain or speaker, so no names are inherited.
The bracketed «[عن الحسن بن علي بن فضال]» is an inserted link and is read as one.
The Imam named after «سمعت» is the last link, written as the report gives him.
